title: perfect tool for rice rinsing
text: perfect tool for rice rinsing. Oh boy. This is REALLY easy to use and the best method I've ever tried to rinse rice with. It's top rack dishwasher safe. If you like to rinse your rice before cooking, this is really worth owning. I've tried so many other methods and this produced the best result with the least amount of waste and loss.  I highly recommend it.
